abstract: Embeds 5,206 problem statements across seven canon branches, draws a frontier at the 10th percentile of solved problems' reach, sorts open problems into reach classes and backtests the rule at cutoffs 2005 and 2021, with frozen forecasts at 2005, 2015 and 2021. Placing the 72 undecided 2005 rows outside narrows the settled-only 2005 gap to 23% against 19%.
